4. 'erformance Requirements
4.1 The dehusker, after installing and running-In in accordance with 6.4 and 6.5 of IS : 9049-1978, shall be operated for half-an-hour at no-load. During the no-load run, the visual observation. shall not indicate the following:

8) b) c) d) e)

Presence of any marked vibration during operation, Presence of any under noise In the dehusker, Unusual heating of any component, Any slippage of belts, Vibration In fan running, f) Non-smooth running of shafts In their respective bearings, and g) Any marked unusual wear or slackness In any components.

4.2 When tested in accordance with the method given in Appendix A, the rated capacity per kWh energy consumed shall be not les8 than 700 kg for parboiled paddy and 500 kg for raw paddy. Various adjustments, clearances and speeds for the rated capacity shall be declared by the manufacturer. 4.2.1 The rice shall not get any visible stain. 4.1.1 During and after the capacity test, the visual observation shall not indicate the following:
a) Observations given in 4.1 (8) to (g), and b) Leakage of grain from the dehusker.

4.3 When tested In accordance with 9.1 of IS : 9049-1979, no breakdown and defects shall develop in any unit of the dehusker.

5. Other Requirements
5.1 The sheet used In construction of various parts shall be of minimum 0'7 mm thickness. 5.1 The axle shall be finished to close tolerances at the bearings and shall be properly aligned. 5.3 Provision shall be made for lubrication of bearings and they shall be dust-proof.
5.4 A feed regulating and spreading system shall be provided.

5.5 Various controls shall be easily accessible and capable of being locked in a chosen position.
S.6 In case of belt drive. provision shall be made for belt tightening. 5 7 Transmission guards shall be provided to prevent accidental contact of persons or parts of ciothing being caught in the transmission system, unless the system is so constructed or placed as to be safe without guards. 5.7.1 The guards shall be so designed as not to hinder in easy adjustment, servicing and operation of dehusker. 5 7.1 It is preferable that all guards shall be either permanently attached or flrmly secured to pre~ent their removal without the aid of the tools. The servicing and adjustments should be possible without complete removal of the guards. 5.7.3 The guards shall have sufficient strength to support load of 1 200 N applied at any point over an area of 0�1 mt without permanent set.
Not. purpose. Depending upon sp.ce available, .r.a and load may be correspondingly Iner��led or d.cr����d fOr t.stlng

'5.8 The Impeller shall be statically balanced.

5.9 The rubber ring and lining shall be firmly flxed. 5.10 The physical properties of rubber shall conform to the requirements given in 5 of IS : 8427-1977. Type and size shall be declared by the manufacture. Arrangement shall be made for easy replacement a8 well as locking of the Impeller.
5.11 The dehusker shall be provided with the operator's manual [ see 4.2 of IS : 8132-1983 Guidelines for presentation of operators manual and technical publications ( first revision) ].

6. Workmanlhlp and Finish
6.1 Welding used for Joining different components shall not be porous and shall be smooth ( see IS : 818-1989 Code of practice for use of metal arc welding for general construction ).

6.1 Any sharp corners and protruding fasteners shalf be avoided. 6.3 Components of the dehusker shall be finished smooth and properly painted.
7. Markin. and Packinl
7.1 Marklng- Each dehusker shall be marked with the following particulars:
a) Manufacturer's name and recognised trade-mark;

b) Model number: c) Batch, code or serial number;

d) Power rating, kw; e) Rated Input capacity; and
f) Direction of rotation of Impeller.

7.1.1 Standard marking -

Details available with the Bureau of Indian Standards.

7.1 Packinl - The dehusker or its components shall be packed as agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier for safe handling In transit and storage.

APPENDIX A
( Clause 4-2 )
METHOD OF TEST FOR PADDY DEHUSKER, CENTRIFUGAL TYPE

A-I. Test Material - Sufficient quantity of cleaned paddy of the same variety having 14�O�5 percent moisture content shall be taken for starting the test. The rice husk ratio of the paddy shall be determined in accordance with 6.3 of IS : 9049-1979. A-2. Installation and Runninl-in - Installation and running-In of the dehusker shall be done in accordance with 6.4 and 6.5 of IS : 9049�1979 respectively.

A-3. Test at Load A-3.1 Operation and Collection of Data - The dehusker shall be operated at the specified speed of the Impeller for one-and-a-half hours at the rated input capacity specified by the manufacturer. A-].I.I During the run period, the following data and samples shall be collected: a) Six samples of shelled paddy at an interval of 15 minutes. b) Speed of the Impeller, and c) Energy meter reading at an interval of 15 minutes In kwh. A-].1.1 At the end of one-and-a-half hour feeding, run the dehusker Idle for some time so that practically no material already fed comes out. At the end of the test, collect and weigh the shelled ~addy received at main grain-outlet. The mass of the sample collected at main grain outlet [see A-3.1.1 (a) ] shall be added to the mass of the shelled paddy collected after the run test. A-3.1 Preparation and Analysis of Samples - Procedure given in 9.1.] of IS : 9049-1979 shall be followed. A-3.3 Calculation - Procedure given in 9.1.4 of IS : 9049-1979 shall be followed. A-3.4 Power Consumption - The difference between the two consecutive energy meter readings [ see A-l.I.1 (c) ] shall be taken as the power consumption for 15 minutes. The power consumption per hour shall be calculated giving due allowance to the type of drive (see 6.4.1.1 of IS : 9049-1979). A-:J.5 Rated Input Capacity - The feed rate shall be considered as rated Input capacity if the shellIng efflclency Is not less than 90 percent and brokens not more than 10 percent. The capacity shall be divided by the power consumed ( see A-3.4 ).

EXPLANATORY NOTE

With the Incre��� of paddy production and rapid modernization of rice mills, centrifugal type paddy dehusker. are being' extensively used throughout the country. A need was f81t to prepare this standard, to help manufacturer. to produce quality machines. For the purpose of d8cldl~ng whether a particular requirement of this standard is complied with the flnal value, observed or calculated, expressing the result of a test or analysis, shall be rounded off In accQfdance with IS : 2-1980 'Rules for rounding off numerical values ( rev/sed )'. The number of slgniflcant places retained In the rounded oft value should be the same 8S that of the specifled value In this standard.
